basic_details.short_information: NTPC is inviting retired executives from PSUs/Govt. Organizations to apply for an Associate position at the HOP Secretariat, NTPC Dadri, for a period of engagement of 1 year. The candidate must have retired at E1-E5 level position from NTPC or an equivalent position, and the upper age limit is 62 years. The application is made through an online Google form, and the last date is 10 November 2026.

how_to_apply: The notice gives one way to apply: the application link (DadriHOPsectt206), which is a Google form at https://forms.gle/5HD36WQL3s1UvxxU6. The form must be submitted on or before 10.11.2026. The notice does not name any document to be attached.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the pay, the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: Associate position for Retired Executives from PSUs/Govt. Organizations

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites retired executives from PSUs/Govt. Organizations. The experience conditions are: The candidate must have retired at E1-E5 level position from NTPC or an equivalent position. Total experience: the candidate should have 20 years of working experience in NTPC, with a minimum of 3 years of working experience in HOP/CEO/RED sect. Upper age limit: 62 years. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility details of the position.

content_sections.text: The associate shall be deployed for various activities at HOP Secretariat, Dadri. The place of posting is NTPC Dadri, and the period of engagement is 1 year.
